contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, bakery and shop windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The coin on the pavement is a scene prop, not a product. Bent forward with one knee flexed: the navy blazer back, the shirt below the belt and the pleated trousers' seat are conservatively reconstructed. The brown belt shows at the front with a silver-tone buckle; its full length is inferred. The watch is a silver-tone round case with a white dial on a brown strap, not a metal bracelet; the strap's hidden side is inferred. No socks are visible, so none are listed. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual view_image review of all five look overview sheets; all 28 isolated products, complete pairs and straps, no outfit collages or props; clean final composites on four backgrounds.

deck.ko: 네이비 블레이저와 회색 플리츠의 가벼운 격식.
deck.en: A navy blazer lends gray pleats an easy formality.

intro.ko: 바닥의 작은 동전을 발견하고 한쪽 무릎을 굽힙니다.
intro.en: Spotting a small coin on the pavement, he bends one knee and reaches down.
intro.de: Eine kleine Münze auf dem Pflaster lässt ihn ein Knie beugen und nach unten greifen.

body.ko: 흰 버튼다운 셔츠가 네이비 블레이저 안을 밝힙니다. 회색 앞 주름 바지와 검정 더비가 단정한 선을 만들고 갈색 벨트와 갈색 스트랩 시계가 작은 색 연결을 더합니다. 숙인 자세에서도 열린 재킷과 여유 있는 바지의 형태가 읽힙니다.
body.en: A white button-down brightens the navy blazer. Gray pleated trousers and black derbies hold a clear line; a brown belt and brown watch strap provide a small color connection. The open jacket and relaxed trousers retain their shape through the bent pose.
body.de: Ein weißes Button-down-Hemd hellt den marineblauen Blazer auf. Graue Bundfalten und schwarze Derbys halten eine klare Linie; brauner Gürtel und braunes Uhrenband verbinden kleine Details. Offene Jacke und lockere Hose bleiben auch in der gebeugten Haltung lesbar.

pull.en: Small details connected by brown straps.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Small details connected by brown straps.

tip.ko: 몸을 숙이기 전 재킷 단추를 풀고 일어난 뒤 셔츠 앞단을 정리하세요.
tip.en: Unbutton before bending and straighten the shirt front after standing up.
tip.de: Vor dem Bücken die Jacke öffnen und danach die Hemdfront glätten.

howToWear.en: Unbutton before bending so the front can move freely.
